badges.name: Clutch Master
badges.blurb: wants the round with the game on the line
badges.impact: Applied when earned (while held): +3 Clutch Factor, +2 Composure. Earning it permanently raised potential by 1.5.
badges.decay: It can fade after 2 seasons without re-qualifying.

attributes.label: Aim Precision
attributes.description: How tight the crosshair placement is at range. Dominates first-bullet accuracy on rifles and long-range Op duels.

attributes.label: Aim Reactivity
attributes.description: Reaction speed + flick repeatability. Matters for peek duels, clutch flicks, re-fragging teammates who die mid-trade.

attributes.label: Clutch Factor
attributes.description: Performance uplift in 1vX and late-round situations. Stacks on top of raw aim; two players with identical mechanics can have wildly different clutch win rates.

attributes.label: Comms Quality
attributes.description: Signal-to-noise of callouts. High comms_quality improves teammates' observation fidelity — they "see" enemies earlier via calls.

attributes.label: Composure
attributes.description: Steadiness under ult-heavy rounds, match points, final maps. Modulates how well the player executes *planned* strats under pressure.

attributes.label: Game Sense
attributes.description: Reads the enemy mid-round. Higher game_sense shortens the latency between a teammate dying and correctly repositioning.

attributes.label: Movement
attributes.description: Counter-strafing, jiggle peeks, bunny-hop defusing. Higher movement reduces the accuracy penalty of strafe-shots and helps first-peek timing.

attributes.label: Positioning
attributes.description: How often the player is in the right angle for the situation. Reduces the chance of dying to crossfires and increases the odds of an anchor holding a site 1vN.

attributes.label: Tilt Resistance
attributes.description: How much performance degrades after losing rounds / pistols / duels. Low tilt_resistance is a volatility multiplier on a match.

attributes.label: Utility Usage
attributes.description: Precision of smokes, molly placements, recon dart lineups. Scales the *effect* of utility, not just whether it's thrown.
